    # check the expiry date is not a future date
    def clean_expiry_date(self):
        expiry_date = self.cleaned_data.get('expiry_date')  # get the typed expiry date
        if expiry_date and expiry_date > date.today():  # block any date after today
            raise forms.ValidationError('Expiry date cannot be a future date. Please pick today or an earlier date.')
        return expiry_date  # give back the checked date
